text: [excited] Third man fine है, लेकिन Fine leg अंदर है — [chuckles] uppercut का scene है, bhai.
english: Third man is fine, but fine leg is inside the circle — it's an uppercut setup, bro.

text: [chuckles] Power का hint है, scene set है.
english: There’s a hint of power, the trap is set.

text: [shouts] Kohli down the ground! [shouts] SIIIIX! क्या sensational hit है!
english: Kohli goes down the ground! SIX! What a sensational hit!

text: [shouts] 68 off 49, bro — Virat Kohli on fire है! [chuckles] Run लिया है, timing tight है.
english: 68 off 49, bro — Virat Kohli is on fire! He has taken a run, timing is tight.

text: [shouts] क्या shot है! [laughs] Pure class, Virat Kohli!
english: What a shot! Pure class, Virat Kohli!
